description: JavaScript source code for managing parental control settings in a device UI, including device list management, URL validation, schedule configuration, and UI interactions.

methods.name: updateSuffix
methods.description: Updates the suffix text for the block site title with the new target name.

methods.name: _prepare_layout
methods.description: Prepares and populates the layout with device and URL data.

methods.name: set_ui_init
methods.description: Initializes the UI with device and parental control policy data.

methods.name: set_dev_list_init
methods.description: Populates the device list with connected devices not already in the parental control list.

methods.name: set_pc_forgot_pwd_init
methods.description: Initializes the password recovery question display.

methods.name: set_dev_rename_init
methods.description: Prepares the device rename dialog with current device name.

methods.name: _pase_url
methods.description: Extracts hostname from a URL, appending '.com' if no TLD is present.

methods.name: valid_url
methods.description: Validates the URL format in input fields.

methods.name: valid_pc_devname
methods.description: Validates the device name input.

methods.name: valid_pc_password
methods.description: Validates the parental control password input.

methods.name: valid_quest_ans
methods.description: Validates the security question and answer inputs.

methods.name: _set_specific_time_select_obj
methods.description: Sets specific time schedule inputs based on selected device.

methods.name: _set_specific_time_select_default
methods.description: Resets specific time schedule inputs to default values.

methods.name: _set_elements_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables UI elements based on device connection and list state.

methods.name: pc_enable_switched
methods.description: Handles enabling or disabling parental control features.

methods.name: pc_device_selected
methods.description: Handles device selection and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: pc_blocktype_radio_selected
methods.description: Updates UI based on selected blocking schedule type.

methods.name: pc_device_add
methods.description: Adds a new device to the parental control list.

methods.name: pc_device_remove
methods.description: Removes a device from the parental control list.

methods.name: pc_device_rename_pop
methods.description: Opens the device rename dialog.

methods.name: pc_device_rename
methods.description: Renames a device in the parental control list.

methods.name: pc_save_password_qa
methods.description: Saves parental control password and security question/answer.

methods.name: pc_password_auth
methods.description: Authenticates parental control password.

methods.name: pc_answer_auth
methods.description: Authenticates parental control security answer.

methods.name: _pop_diag
methods.description: Displays a dialog box with specified actions.

methods.name: pc_applied
methods.description: Handles applying parental control settings, prompting for password setup if needed.

methods.name: pc_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes parental control data from the server.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves the current parental control configuration to the server.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful save operation.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed save operation.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends parental control data to the server.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of parental control data.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed retrieval of parental control data.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches parental control data from the server.

methods.name: get_info_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful device info retrieval.

methods.name: get_info_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed device info retrieval.

methods.name: get_info_data
methods.description: Fetches device info data.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes the page by loading device info and parental control data.
